utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-04-75-T, The Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. For the Prosecution, Douglas Stringer, Lisa Biersay, Thomas Laugel, and legal intern Adin Samson.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence, Mr. Zivanovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic and Christopher Gosnell. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. The witness -- the witness may be brought in. It's GH-165. That's closed session, I suppose?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: If I remember well. Can we go into closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay. Now we are in open session. So what -- what I was conveying to you, Mr. Stringer, and to the parties in general, is that the Court, unfortunately -- the Tribunal -- the Chamber - sorry - the Chamber, unfortunately, will not be able to sit the week of 22nd of July. That probably -- I thought you were already informed about that. That will probably change your -- your programme. As -- as for now, I -- I see that, for tomorrow, we have 154; is that right? Or is there a problem as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: That's the problem, Is that because 150 dropped out, we were not able to get 154 accelerated. And so we're proposing, then, to begin with GH-154's evidence first thing Wednesday morning which we believe will not raise any issues with going beyond the end of Thursday.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Indeed, it looks like two hear days will perfectly suffice. So that means that for today we're done.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. President, if I could, just to clarify for in the summer recess period, then, so that we would not be sitting the week of the 22nd of July, but this is -- we are going to still, in addition, be retaining the published summer recess which we've been going on so that, just to, if I may, Mr. President, just confirm that we would then expect to call our first witness on the 19th of August, which is ...

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Very well. Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. If nothing else, Court adjourned

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 10th of July, 2013, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.00 p.m.,
